card.name: Linking words in combination-therapy phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with" or "and" right after "in combination" or a drug name, just before a partner drug or chemotherapy is named. Mostly in immunotherapy labels (IMFINZI, JEMPERLI).

modes.label: In combination with
modes.description: The word "with" after "in combination" or a dose, leading to a partner treatment.
modes.example: IMFINZI 1,500 mg in combination<< with>> chemotherapy every 3 weeks for up to

modes.label: Joining paired drugs
modes.description: "and" or "or" joining two drugs or items in a list of regimens.
modes.example: JEMPERLI, in combination with carboplatin<< and>> paclitaxel, for primary
